'''Ani'anti''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], henchman and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Ani'anti raided the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] in his [[Ixiyen-class fast attack craft|''Ixiyen''-class fast attack craft]].<ref name="SWG:CS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempBlackSunSpaceComm.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Ani'anti]]
Ani'anti appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Henchman Ani'anti was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. Henchman Ani'anti was a starfighter boss that had a low probability to spawn among a group of Black Sun starfighters in the Corellian system.<ref name="SWG:CS" />
